doc_title_en: Notice of Share Exchange Agreement Execution (Simplified Share Exchange) for Complete Subsidiary Status of Sharing Innovations Inc. by Orchestra Holdings Inc.
doc_title_jp: 株式会社Orchestra Holdingsによる株式会社Sharing Innovationsの完全子会社化に関する株式交換契約締結（簡易株式交換）のお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: DX事業を取り巻く環境変化への対応、グループ内経営資源の一体的活用、迅速な意思決定、上場維持コスト削減（年4,000～5,000万円）

summary_en: Orchestra Holdings to acquire Sharing Innovations via simplified share exchange, making it a wholly owned subsidiary effective 2026-11-30. Sharing Innovations stock to delist from TSE Growth Market 2026-11-26. Acquisition driven by need for integrated decision-making and resource utilization within DX business; Sharing Innovations facing headwinds including annual listing costs of ¥40–50M and reduced engineer staffing post-2024.
summary_jp: Orchestra Holdings が簡易株式交換により Sharing Innovations を完全子会社化、2026年11月30日発効予定。同日前の2026年11月26日に東証グロース市場から上場廃止。上場維持コスト年4,000～5,000万円削減と経営資源の一体的活用が狙い。
tag_en: M&A - Orchestra Holdings acquires Sharing Innovations (complete subsidiary via share exchange) - effective 2026-11-30
